1.content: Select a safe move that strictly reduces the Manhattan distance to the goal. If none exist, choose a safe move that leaves the distance unchanged; if still none, consider safe moves that increase the distance. Only when no safe moves are available may unsafe moves be considered.

2.content: Rate moves that would land on a hole (H) or any known hazard extremely low, regardless of whether they reduce Manhattan distance.

3.content: When multiple safe moves equally reduce Manhattan distance to the goal, prioritize moves that maximize the Manhattan distance to the nearest known hazard.
